label: Wizard's Quarters
safeSceneProfile: Wizard's private quarters; use guarded room text and separate furnishings/actors, without inventing readable spell answers.

guardedRoomSource.sourceText:
<ROUTINE WIZARD-QUARTERS-FCN (RARG "AUX" PICK L)
	 <COND (<EQUAL? .RARG ,M-LOOK ,M-FLASH>
		<TELL
"This is where the Wizard of Frobozz lives. The room is ">
		<SET L <GET ,WIZQDESCS 0>>
		<SET PICK <RANDOM .L>>
		<COND (<EQUAL? .PICK ,WIZQLAST>
		       <COND (<EQUAL? .PICK .L>
			      <SET PICK <- .PICK 1>>)
			     (T
			      <SET PICK <+ .PICK 1>>)>)>
		<SETG WIZQLAST .PICK>
		<TELL <GET ,WIZQDESCS .PICK> CR>)>>
